title: Dataset Ingestion Blocker: Byte-Identical Duplicate Payload in Row 120 vs Row 34
evidence: Row 34 (Member3Animals/fun-animal-facts-for-kids.jpg) and Row 120 (Member3Gardening/fun-animal-facts-for-kids.jpg) share identical SHA-256 e9821bdd4fd24a00abf2965d542287e7b969704501f1323acb10b62e9672dd56. Metadata claims 'Garden Friends: Earthworms at Work' but payload is an animal-facts infographic. Exhaustive search confirmed no genuine earthworm source asset exists locally.
actual_behavior: Staging adapter fails closed with RuntimeError: duplicate media bytes detected: 'fun-animal-facts-for-kids.jpg' and 'fun-animal-facts-for-kids.jpg', aborting dry-run ingestion.
required_fix: Obtain genuine source image for Garden Friends: Earthworms at Work from original dataset collector, replace the Gardening payload, recalculate SHA-256, update CSV Row 120, and repackage Part 2 bundle. Do not generate synthetic imagery.
acceptance_test: python -m tools.dataset_bundle_ingest completes dry run with 206 unique SHA-256 media assets and 0 duplicate errors.

title: Local Host Tooling Gap: Flutter SDK Not Installed on Windows Workstation
evidence: 'flutter' is not recognized as an internal or external command on host workstation. Android SDK (adb v37.0.1) and Java OpenJDK 17 are installed, but Flutter CLI binary is absent from PATH.
actual_behavior: Local compilation of mobile_flutter cannot be completed directly on the host machine. Relies on remote CI runners (.github/workflows/flutter-native.yml).
required_fix: Install Flutter SDK on the development machine (or utilize GitHub Actions runner) to execute local 'flutter pub get', 'flutter analyze', and 'flutter test'.
acceptance_test: flutter analyze and flutter test pass cleanly with 0 errors on local host.

title: Curated Dataset Not Yet Wired into Feed Recommendation API
evidence: Migration 20260908195500_curated_dataset_foundation.sql created curated_content, curated_media_assets, feed_sessions, and feed_session_items. However, services/recommendation.py:candidates() only queries the child 'posts' table.
actual_behavior: Curated media items cannot be merged into child feeds or reels; children with 0 social connections experience empty-feed starvation.
required_fix: Update recommendation candidate generator to sample from published curated_content, balance with social posts, and implement empty-graph curated fallback.
acceptance_test: GET /api/mobile/feed/ returns curated candidates when child has 0 social connections.

title: Authentication Scope Discrepancy: SMS and Certificate Auth Missing
evidence: 0 references to SMS gateways or client X.509 certificates exist across the codebase. Email OTP via Resend is the only implemented 2FA mechanism.
actual_behavior: SMS authentication is completely absent. Certificate authentication refers only to standard server TLS verification.
required_fix: Document 'SMS NOT IMPLEMENTED' in project submission. Do not claim SMS authentication. Clarify that 'certificate authentication' refers to TLS/HTTPS transport security.
acceptance_test: Submission documentation accurately reflects email-only OTP and TLS transport encryption.

title: YOLO Policy Vocabulary vs. Model Checkpoint Discrepancy
evidence: config/safety_policy.yaml configures 98 distinct dangerous/review object labels across 7 families. The loaded yolov8n.pt model exposes 80 generic COCO classes with limited specialized weapon labels.
actual_behavior: YAML policy vocabulary exceeds the single COCO-80 model detection scope. Specialized labels require multi-model ensembles or remote Modal AI vision models.
required_fix: Document configured policy vocabulary separately from model checkpoint coverage in technical report.
acceptance_test: Audit documentation explicitly reports both numbers (98 configured vs 80 COCO classes).
